Skip Privacy Statement for Customers
This Privacy Statement (“Statement”) explains how SkipTheDishes Restaurant Services Inc. ("Skip", "we", "us", "our", etc.) collects, uses and discloses Personal Data (as defined below) of customers on our website located at: www.skipthedishes.com, or the various associated websites, platforms or applications (collectively and each individually, the "Skip Platform").

At Skip we are committed to protecting the privacy of everyone in our community and who makes use of our services. By visiting and/or using the Skip Platform, you consent to the collection, use, storage, disclosure and transfer of your Personal Data as set out in this Statement. In some cases, we may ask you to provide explicit consent if we intend to process your Personal Data otherwise than as indicated in this Statement, however sometimes your consent may be implied through your conduct with us.

Restaurants, convenience stores, grocery stores and other businesses that offer products for delivery (“Partners”) on the Skip Platform may offer their products for delivery directly through the Skip Platform, or may use the Skip Platform to provide delivery services for orders placed on the Partner’s own website, application or ordering platform. In such circumstances, we will process data received from such Partners in accordance with this Statement.

If you do not agree with any part of this Statement you should not conduct any transactions on the Skip Platform, navigate away from the Skip Platform immediately, and uninstall our application.

What and why we process personal data
Personal Data (or “your Data”) means any information or set of information from which we are able, directly or indirectly, to personally identify you, in particular by reference to an identifier e.g. name, email address, phone number, etc. Personal Data does not include data where the identity has been removed (anonymous data). Whenever you interact with the Skip Platform we collect and process your Personal Data. Skip may process your Personal Data for the following purposes:

1. Customer Accounts
If you interact with the Skip Platform you are given the opportunity to create an account with us. We use this information to administer your account, enable your access to the Skip Platform, verify your identity as an authorized user concerning your account, and to implement, carry out and maintain security measures aimed at protecting our customers from identity theft, fraud and unauthorized access to an account. The following Personal Data must be provided by you when you sign up for an account:

Name
Contact data
Password of your selection
You may choose to register for an account with us via a third-party social media network, including Facebook, Apple and Google ("Social Media"). If you do so, you authorize us to access certain Social Media account information consistent with your Social Media privacy settings, including your name. We use this information to administer your account, and to enable your access to the Skip Platform.

At the time of signing up for an account, we also automatically collect your IP address and device information.

2. Ordering process
We process the Personal Data you provide to us when you place an order. This Personal Data is needed to confirm and execute your order, and to process your payment, and a possible refund (if applicable). We process the following Personal Data in the ordering process:

Name
Delivery address data
Contact data
Order and transaction data
Payment data
Age verification data
At the time of placing an order, we also automatically collect your IP address and device information, to help protect against theft, fraud and unauthorized access to an account.

We collect your order history including the date, time, cost, order type (takeout or delivery order), physical address and delivery instructions (if a delivery order), method of purchase, and order details, including specific food items ordered and special order instructions. We use this information to ensure that your order has been completed, to allow you to select previously entered addresses for future deliveries and to improve our service offerings.

When you place an order for delivery, you may communicate with the courier delivering your order via phone, text or in-app or web chat. We collect this Communications Data including date and time, as well as the content of text or in-app messages. We process this data for the purposes of customer service and fraud detection and prevention.

Upon delivery, the courier delivering your order may take and provide to you and/or us a picture of the delivered order. This is for the purpose of supporting any inquiries you or your courier may have about the delivery of your order.

Please be aware that if you submit an order for alcohol, you will be asked to provide government-issued identification upon delivery, and Skip may process age verification data (such as your date of birth), to confirm that you are of legal age.

Payment operations are outsourced to our payment processors and we do not store your credit card information in our systems other than the first four and last four digits of the credit card number.

3. Partner and courier reviews
We may offer you the opportunity to submit a review of couriers and/or Partners on the Skip Platform. We may process the following Personal Data when you post a restaurant review:

Name
Contact data
Review
When your review is published, the review, your first name and the initial of your last name, may be made available to couriers and/or Partners. Restaurants may be provided with the opportunity to respond to your feedback. You also consent to us using such reviews (but not your name and contact information) in any marketing or advertising materials.

4. Customer services and support
When you contact our customer services support, we will use the Personal Data you provide to answer your question or handle your complaint. We process the following Personal Data for customer service purposes:

Name
Address data (if applicable)
Contact data
Order and transaction data
Payment data (if applicable)
Comments and Communications Data (if applicable)
We may process Personal Data via call recordings to provide customer support, including to investigate and address user concerns and to monitor and improve our customer support responses and processes.

We retain the above information to assist you in the future and to improve our customer service and service offerings, and for training and quality purposes.

5. Social media:
We may offer you the opportunity to otherwise engage with Skip or its content on or through Social Media. When you engage with us through Social Media websites, plug-ins and applications, you may allow us to have access to and disclose certain information associated with your Social Media account (e.g., name, username, email address, profile picture) to deliver content or as part of the operation of the website, plug-in or application.

6. Loyalty programs
Skip offers loyalty programs to provide you with discounts. When you make use of one of our loyalty programs, we process your Personal Data to provide you with the discounts or offers as set out in the respective loyalty program.

We process the following Personal Data for Skip Rewards:

Address data
Order history
We process the following Personal Data for “Refer a Friend”:

Your name and contact data
Name and contact data of the recipient
We do not use the names or contact data submitted in these circumstances for any other purpose without the consent of you or the email recipient to do so. Please ensure that you only submit contact data of individuals with whom you have a personal or family relationship and who would want to receive the message.

We process the following Personal Data for promotional partnerships and offers:

Transaction data
We may receive from promotional partners data (including Personal Data) to verify your entitlement to applicable offers/discounts, to detect and prevent fraud and process any applicable offers/discounts. Promotional partners are independently responsible for the collection and use of any Personal Data that they share with us. You can find more information on how they handle your Personal Data in their respective privacy policies.

7. Customer research
To make sure that our services are aligned with your preferences and to improve our services and platforms, Skip may approach you to conduct customer research such as but not limited to, surveys, user testing and focus groups. We only send you these types of communications with your prior consent, unless this is not necessary according to the applicable law. Participation in the customer research is completely voluntary. If you do not wish to receive communications about customer research you can unsubscribe from them in the messages itself. Skip may process the following Personal Data for research purposes:

Name
Contact data
Order and transaction data
Research input
8. Analytics
Skip uses your Personal Data to create data in aggregate and/or de-identified format to conduct internal analytics, improve the Skip Platform including our range of products and services and any other legally permissible purpose.

9. Marketing and other communications
We process your Personal Data to send you (personalized) marketing messages and notifications. Such messages include the latest news, discounts, products and services (including offers of products, services and discounts from select third parties, as described below under “Sharing with others”), updates about new Partners and other communications that may be the subject of direct marketing. We may contact you by telephone, SMS/MMS and email and if you use our mobile application, via push notification.

We will not send you any direct marketing communications unless you have separately consented to receive such communications or such consent has been deemed to have been given under applicable law. If you no longer wish to receive direct marketing communications, you can opt-out using the unsubscribe mechanism in the marketing communication itself (e.g. by clicking the unsubscribe link at the bottom of an email or by replying with the word "STOP" to an SMS/MMS or by following other provided instructions). To manage push notifications, go to the settings page of your phone or tablet and change the push notification permission for the Skip app. If you switch off in-app push notifications, you will no longer receive updates on your orders via push.

Skip uses cookies and similar technologies to show you personalized ads targeted to your interests (“Interest-Based Advertising”). To learn more about Interest-Based Advertising, or to opt out of online interest-based advertising from a list of companies participating in the Digital Advertising Alliance of Canada at any time, visit http://youradchoices.ca/choices. To learn more about Interest-Based Advertising in mobile apps and to opt out of this type of advertising by third-party advertising companies that participate in the DAAC’s AppChoices tool, please download the version of AppChoices for your device at https://youradchoices.ca/appchoices/.

On your mobile device, you may choose the “Ask App not to Track” setting (in iOS devices) or a setting to “Opt-out of Interest-Based Ads” (on Android), which allows you to limit the use of information about your use of apps for purposes of serving ads targeted to your interests.

As part of our Interest-Based Advertising, we may use services provided by third-party platforms (such as Social Media and other websites) to serve targeted advertisements on such platforms to you, and we may provide a hashed version of your email address or other information to the platform provider for such purposes.

To opt in or out of the use of your information for Interest-Based Advertising you can toggle the Marketing Cookie “on” or “off” in the Cookie Settings in your Skip account. Please be aware that, even if you opt out of Interest-Based Advertising, you may continue to receive ads from us, but they will not be served using interest-based information about you. Also, to successfully opt out, you must have cookies enabled in your web browser. If your browser is configured to reject cookies when you visit these opt-out webpages, or you subsequently erase your cookies, use a different device or web browser, your opt-out instruction may not, or may no longer, be effective. Your opt-out selections only apply to the web browser you use so you must opt out of each web browser on each device that you use. Once you opt out, if you delete your browser’s saved cookies, you may need to opt out again.

We may also process your Personal Data to notify you occasionally about important changes or developments to the Skip Platform, products, services or your account. You cannot opt out of receiving notifications of important changes or developments (e.g. to this Statement or the Terms of Service/Use) unless you discontinue use of the Skip Platform.

We process the following Personal Data for marketing and communication purposes:

Name
Address data
Contact data
Order and transaction data
Review(s) (optional)
Campaign data (optional)
DeviceID
Cookie and Technology data
10. Cookies and App analytics
Skip and its third party service providers use cookies or similar technologies for functional, analytical, and marketing purposes. A “cookie” is a tiny element of data that the Skip Platform can send to your browser, which may then be stored on your web browser or mobile device so we can recognize you when you return. Data processed for cookie purposes defer per purpose (functional, analytical or marketing) and depend on the preferences set by you.

Please see the “Marketing and other communications” section for more information on how Skip uses cookies for marketing purposes.

Functional Cookies are used to ensure our website remembers your choices and provides better functionality and personalized features. For example, cookies make it possible to remember your delivery address.

Analytical Cookies are used to improve our website and our visitors’ experience by analyzing the behaviors and usage patterns of visitors to the Skip Platform. Skip uses Google Analytics to collect, process, store and analyze information when you visit the Skip Platform, including IP address, your location when the Skip mobile application is used, device identifiers, browser characteristics, operating system details, language preferences, referring URLs, length of visits, pages viewed and other related information. You can obtain additional information on Google Analytics’ collection and processing of data and data privacy and security, including how to learn more about opting out of Google Analytics’ data collection by visiting the Google Analytics website.

You may set your web browser or smartphone to notify you when you receive a cookie or to not accept certain cookies. It is also possible to delete already placed cookies. By disabling cookies it is possible that parts of our website will no longer work. By clicking on one of the links below you will find how you can change your settings per browser and possibly delete your cookies:

Chrome
Firefox
Internet Explorer
Edge
Safari (iOS)

Cookies that are needed for our website and its features to function (Necessary Cookies) cannot be deactivated.

11. Campaigns
From time to time, Skip may launch contests, sweepstakes or promotions (“Campaigns”) in connection to its services. Joining Skip campaigns or contests is always on a voluntary basis. Skip processes the following Personal Data for the purposes of administering your participation in the Campaign:

Name
Contact data
Order and transaction data (optional)
Campaign data (optional)
12. Fraud prevention/detection and network security
We process Personal Data to implement, carry out and maintain security measures aimed at protecting ourselves and our customers from identity theft, fraud and unauthorized access to an account, and to prevent and/or detect fraud and other forms of misuse on the Skip Platform. Personal Data processed for fraud prevention and detection and network security purposes are:

Name
Order and transaction data
Payment data
Browser information
IP Address
Device information
Communications Data
13. Skip Pay
We process Personal Data if you use your Skip Pay allowance to pay for an order you placed on the Skip Platform and to provide you with the digital allowance.

The following Personal Data may be processed in connection with Skip Pay:

Name
Employment data (job role, department, contractual hours)
Contact data
Allowance data
Order and transaction data
Payment data
Other data related to your usage of Skip Pay, to operate Skip Pay and to provide you the Skip Pay service.
14. Gift cards
When you purchase a gift card for use on the Skip Platform, your payment card information (including payment card number, security code, expiration date, cardholder name and billing address) is transmitted using the secure services of our payment processors for the purposes of processing your payment. We collect the gift card sender’s email address and recipient’s name and email address. We use this information to deliver and manage the gift card.

Additional purposes
We will only use your Personal Data for the purposes described above. If we want to use the data for a different purpose, we will take appropriate measures to inform you, consistent with the significance of the changes we make. Where required by applicable data protection law, we will obtain your consent.

Age
This Skip Platform is not intended for persons defined as underage by applicable local laws, nor do we intend to collect Personal Data of website visitors who are under the defined legal age. However, we are unable to verify visitors’ ages. We therefore advise parents and/or legal guardians to monitor their children's online activities, to prevent their Personal Data being collected without parental consent. If you feel that we have collected Personal Data of a minor without consent, please email or write to us at the contact information set out below.

Automated decision-making
In the performance of our contract with you and to improve our platform, Skip and its service providers uses Personal Data to render decisions based exclusively on automated processing for the following purposes:

Provide our services to you (for example, Skip uses your address data and/or location data to show you available Partners in your local area);
Customer service purposes (for example, using chatbots);
Network security and fraud detection/prevention purposes.
Please see below for information on how you can submit your observations regarding the automated decision making which affects you or when such automated decision-making and/or profiling leads to a negative decision about you, and you do not agree with it.

How long we store Personal Data for
We will only retain your Personal Data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, tax, accounting, or reporting requirements. We may retain certain data as necessary to prevent fraud or future abuse, or for legitimate business purposes, such as analysis of aggregated, non-personal information, or if required or permitted by law. To determine the appropriate retention period for Personal Data, we consider the amount, nature, and sensitivity of the Personal Data, the potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure of your Personal Data, the purposes for which we process your Personal Data and whether we can achieve those purposes through other means, and applicable legal and contractual requirements.

In some circumstances we may anonymise your Personal Data so that it can no longer be associated with you, in which case we may use such information without further notice to you.

Sharing with couriers and Partners on the Skip Platform
Skip will share your Personal Data (order, name, and telephone number) with the Partner you selected, so that the Partner can process and prepare your order. Skip will also share your name and address data to the courier for the purposes of delivering your order.

Sharing data for Skip Pay
If you use your Skip Pay allowance to pay for an order you placed via the Skip Platform, Skip shares your Personal Data with the person that grants you the allowance (which might be your employer, business partner, etc.). The person that grants you the allowance has their own responsibility and obligation with respect to the processing of your Personal Data. The person that grants you the allowance also shares your Personal Data with us to allow us to provide Skip Pay services to you.

Sharing with others
Skip may work with other companies within the JET Group (which means our subsidiaries and affiliates, our ultimate holding company and its subsidiaries and affiliates) and other third parties and service providers in order to carry out the processing described above and/or to comply with legal obligations.

These group companies and service providers will process your Personal Data on behalf of us and have access to your Personal Data for the purposes described in this privacy notice, including processing credit card payments and providing services or products to us.

We may share your Personal Data with select third parties, including Partners, advertising and marketing companies and promotional partners, so that we or they may contact you about our or their products or services that may be of interest to you (subject to compliance with Canada's anti-spam legislation). Such third parties may contact you by mail, telephone, mobile messaging (e.g. SMS, MMS, etc.) or email. If you change your mind about being contacted by these parties in the future, please let us know by using the contact details set out at the end of this Statement or by following other provided instructions.

From time to time we use your information (e.g. specific contact data or aggregated order data) to help us and our third parties understand users of the Skip Platform, the effectiveness of the order and delivery services and to enhance our and our partners product and service offerings.

By submitting your Personal Data, you agree to the transfer, storing or processing as described above. We will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that your personal information is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Statement.

Additionally, we may use the Personal Data that you provide to us if we are under a duty to disclose or share your Data in order to comply with (and/or where we believe we are under a duty to comply with) any applicable legal obligation; or in order to enforce the Terms of Service/Use and any other agreement we have with you. This includes exchanging Personal Data with other companies and other organizations for the purposes of fraud protection and prevention. We and our service providers may use or disclose your Personal Data in response to a search warrant or other legally valid inquiry or order, or to another organization for the purposes of investigating a breach of an agreement or contravention of law or detecting, suppressing or preventing fraud, or as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law or legal process. Your Personal Data may also be used or disclosed where necessary or desirable for the establishment, exercise or defense of legal claims and to investigate or prevent actual or suspected loss or harm to persons or property.

If our business enters into a joint venture with, purchases or is sold to or merged with another business entity, your Personal Data may be disclosed or transferred to the target company, our new business partners or owners or their advisors provided that the information disclosed continues to be used for the purposes permitted by this Statement by the entity acquiring the information.

Your Personal Data may be shared with the following parties:

JET Group
Software providers
Advertising and marketing companies, and promotional partners
Implementation partners
Payment and card service providers
User testing, survey and research partners
Professional advisors
Law enforcement, regulatory bodies and/or government agencies
Prospective buyers
Any other third party provided that you have given your consent to the disclosure
Third-party websites
Our website may include links to third-party websites. When you click on such a link, you will leave our service and go to another site. When accessing such third-party websites, bear in mind that each of these websites has its own privacy statement and Skip is not responsible for the collection, use or disclosure of Personal Data by such third party websites. Although Skip takes great care in selecting websites to link to, we cannot take responsibility for the way in which they handle your Personal Data.

Where your data gets sent
The Personal Data you provide to us will be held on our servers which may be in Canada, the United States, Australia, Japan, United Kingdom and/or Ireland. In addition, your Personal Data may be accessed by or provided to our staff working outside of Canada (and outside of Quebec) and/or to service providers and/or to third parties including companies within JET Group who may be located outside of Canada (and outside of Quebec) and act for us for the purposes set out in this Statement or for other purposes notified to you. For example, we may send Personal Data outside of Canada (and outside of Quebec) for processing and storage by other companies within the JET Group of companies or by our or their service providers.

While your Personal Data is outside of Canada, it is subject to the laws of the country in which it is held, and may be subject to disclosure to the governments, courts or law enforcement or regulatory agencies of such other country, pursuant to the laws of such country. Certain countries outside Canada and the European Economic Area do not always have equivalent strong data protection laws irrespective of the safeguards we have put in place for the protection of your information in accordance with this Statement.

When we transfer Personal Data outside of Canada (and outside of Quebec) we will take into account any applicable statutory obligations relevant to Personal Data transfers and rely on appropriate safeguards.

Personal Data Rights and questions or complaints
You can exercise the rights provided for by applicable data protection laws, which may include: the right to request access to and/or rectification of your Personal Data, the right to cease dissemination (in Quebec), the right to submit observations of automated decision making (in Quebec) and the right to withdraw your consent (subject to legal and contractual restrictions and provided that reasonable notice is given to us), as well as to lodge a complaint with a regulatory authority directly (collectively, “Personal Data Rights”). Your Personal Data Rights are subject to certain exceptions and restrictions prescribed by law.

To exercise your Personal Data Rights or submit a question (including any questions you might have about Skip’s governance policies and practices regarding Personal Data) or complaint, please email or write to us at the contact information set out below. We may request certain information from you for the purposes of verifying the identity of the individual seeking access to their Personal Data records and may restrict access to certain Personal Data as required or permitted by applicable law or legal process.

If you withdraw your consent to receive information regarding certain products, publications, services or events being offered by Skip, you will no longer receive those types of communications.

You may request the deletion of your account by clicking the Delete Account button on iOS or Android devices or by requesting account deletion via email stating that your Skip Account must be deleted. You may also cease the use of the Skip Platform, the Skip Services and uninstall and remove all local software components thereof, if any. Please note that the data linked to your account will be deleted in accordance with our retention policies.

Security
Skip and JET Group takes Personal Data protection very seriously and we therefore take appropriate administrative, technical and physical measures to protect your Personal Data against misuse, loss, unauthorised access, unwanted disclosure, and unauthorised alteration. The transmission of information via the internet is not completely secure. Although we will take steps to protect your Personal Data, we cannot guarantee the security of your Personal Data or other data transmitted to the Skip Platform; any transmission is at your own risk. If you feel that your Personal Data is not adequately protected or there are indications of misuse, please contact us on: security-concerns@takeaway.com.

How to contact us
If you have any questions or concerns about this Statement and/or our privacy practices, or if you would like to exercise your Personal Data Rights or submit a concern or complaint, please contact us at:

Data Protection Officer
SkipTheDishes Restaurant Services Inc.
Suite 410 - 242 Hargrave Street
Winnipeg, Manitoba, R3C 0M8

or by email at privacy@skipthedishes.com

Updates to this Privacy Statement
We may update this Privacy Statement from time to time in response to changing legal, technical or business developments. Your continued use of the Skip Platform after any change of our Statement will constitute your acceptance of the revised terms of this Statement.

We encourage you to periodically review this Statement for the latest information on our privacy practices. When we update our Privacy Statement, we will take appropriate measures to inform you, consistent with the significance of the changes we make. Where required by applicable data protection law, we will obtain your consent to any material changes to this Statement.

This Privacy Statement was last updated on 08-03-2023.

Changes to this privacy statement

Your privacy rights
Rights with respect to the processing of personal data

In certain cases, you can also ask us to limit the processing of your personal data, erase your data, transfer your data to another data controller or have it deleted. If you wish to do any of these, please send a request to our Privacy Officer: datenschutz@logpay.de and indicate that it concerns a personal data request.
Please enclose a copy of your identity document so that we can be sure that you are the person submitting the request. Make sure that you black out your passport photograph and citizen service number. This is to protect your privacy. Also provide your private address. You will receive an overview of your data or a response to your request within one month of your request. We store this information until we are sure that you are satisfied with our response.
Consent

Please note that withdrawal has no retroactive effect.
Right to make a complaint
You can make a complaint about the processing of your personal data. If we do not meet your request for access, rectification, objection, restriction, erasure or transfer of your personal data, you can submit a complaint with your local or in other way competent Data Protection Authority. The competent Data Protection Authority for LogPay Transport Services GmbH is Der Hessische Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit, Gustav-Stresemann-Ring 1, 65189 Wiesbaden.

Choice Hotels International, Inc. European Economic Area Privacy and Security Notice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. and its subsidiaries (“Choice”, “we” or “us”) are committed to providing you with an efficient and customized Internet experience. Choice complies with applicable privacy and data protection laws, including the European Union’s (EU) General Data Protection Regulation. This Privacy and Security Notice (“Notice”) explains who we are, how we collect, share, and use personal information about you, and how you can exercise your privacy rights.

This policy was last updated: 13 February 2023. 

TERMS OF USE

ABOUT CHOICE HOTELS
Choice Hotels International (NYSE: CHH) is one of the largest and most successful lodging companies in the world. Choice currently franchises more than 6,800 hotels, representing more than 500,000 rooms, in more than 35 countries and territories. Ranging from limited service to full service hotels in the economy, mid-scale and upscale segments, Choice-branded properties provide business and leisure travelers with a range of high-quality, high-value lodging options throughout the United States and internationally. For more information on Choice Hotels, visit the company’s Website www.choicehotels.com.

FRANCHISED HOTELS & YOUR PRIVACY
Hotels franchised under Choice’s brand (“Franchised Hotels”) are independently owned and operated. As a result, your personal information collected or maintained directly by Franchised Hotels is processed by Franchised Hotels as a data controller of your personal information. Your personal information is not subject to this notice unless such information has been shared with us. If your information has been shared with us, we will process your information in accordance with this Notice. For example, if you book a reservation directly with a Franchised Hotel and that hotel utilizes our proprietary property management system, your personal information related to that reservation will be transmitted to and processed by Choice. We do not control the collection, use, or access of your information by the Franchised Hotels and their staff. The Franchised Hotel is the merchant who collects and processes credit card information and receives payment for your stay. The Franchised Hotels are subject to the merchant rules of the credit card processors they select, which establish credit card security rules and procedures.

What personal information does Choice collect and process and for what purposes?
Purposes for Processing

We and our affiliates use the personal information to administer our business activities, provide customer service, personalize your digital experience, contact you concerning your stay with a Franchised Hotel, and make other products and services available to you. Legal Basis for Processing

When Choice processes personal information, we do so under one of the following legal bases:

Consent – as applicable, we offer individuals a choice on whether to participate in a program, and/or an option of how much personal information to provide. Where the processing is based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw consent at any time. Processing based on consent is marked below with “C.”
Contract – the processing is necessary for performing a contract to which you are, or will be, a party. Processing based on a contract is marked below with “K.”
Compliance with legal obligations – some of the personal information we collect is required by the laws of the countries where individuals live and in which we do business. These are marked below with “LO.” When personal information is processed because Choice has a legal obligation to do so, your failure to provide such information may have negative consequences, including the inability to maintain a customer relationship with Choice.
Legitimate interests – often, the personal information we collect is processed because Choice has a legitimate interest in doing so, which is not outweighed by your fundamental rights. This includes information necessary to administer the programs and services we offer. Legitimate interest processing is marked below with “LI.”
What we collect and process
The types of personal information Choice collects and processes may include any or all of the below.
Our websites and mobile applications may receive and store information based on your browser settings, which may include your browser type and operating system, the various Choice web pages you view, Internet Protocol ("IP") addresses, unique device identifiers, and sites visited before viewing our websites. LI
When applicable, we may compensate other websites that include links to our websites. Some information, such as information about the website you were on when you clicked the link to visit Choice’s website, is exchanged to verify the link. LI, K
If you have enabled the location settings on your device while our mobile app is open, we may also receive your precise geo-location information. C
If you have location settings turned off while our mobile app is open, we may receive your general location (country, state, city) information. LI

Use our reservation system, call our toll-free reservation telephone number or create an online account; C
Become a Choice Privileges member; K
Elect to receive offers; C
Respond to our surveys; C
Purchase a gift card. C
If you choose to earn airline miles or other third-party loyalty program points for your award-eligible stay at a Franchised Hotel, we will ask you to provide us your membership number for such loyalty program. C
Choice may occasionally conduct sweepstakes and contests that offer you the opportunity to win prizes. As part of entering a sweepstakes, certain personal information such as name, mailing address, e-mail address and Choice Privileges number may be required. C
When you request information regarding franchise opportunities from our informational website http://www.choicehotelsfranchise.com or elsewhere, we may collect information such as your contact details, your hotel ownership or development experience, the brand you are interested in, and the anticipated investment amount. C

How is personal information used?
Reservations – ​

Your personal information (including credit card number) will be processed primarily in the United States to complete your transaction and to facilitate making future reservations. Only that personal information which is reasonably required to facilitate your reservation is collected and shared between Choice and the Franchised Hotel. LI
 
We will use your e-mail address to send a confirmation and, if necessary, might use the other information to contact you regarding your reservation. LI
 
We may also use your e-mail address to:
send you travel-related messages, stay details, and provide other information about the area and the Franchised Hotel; LI
notify you about special offers and promotions; C and
send you periodic satisfaction or market research surveys. LI
Such information may also be sent to you through our mobile apps, if you elect to receive notifications and alerts.
 
Marketing, Sweepstakes & Contests –
​We may use your personal information to send you via e-mail, telephone, mobile app or postal mail promotions, third party offers, sweepstakes and contests. C
Choice Privileges Members –
If you are a Choice Privileges member, we will use your personal information to perform certain administrative tasks necessary for the administration and operation of the program such as: (1) allowing you to earn Choice Privileges points for point-eligible stays at various Franchised Hotels; and (2) redeem Choice Privileges points for free nights and other rewards offered by the program. K
 
We may also use your personal information to send you via e-mail, telephone, mobile app or postal mail:
program details and satisfaction surveys; LI
account summaries; C
promotions, third party offers, sweepstakes and contests; C
information about applying for the Choice Privileges Visa® card issued by Barclays Bank Delaware (Barclay card member FDIC, pursuant to license from Visa USA Inc.). C
Choice Privileges members’ personal information may be collected through Choice’s websites, mobile applications, call centers, or paper applications, or may be passed on to Choice by Franchised Hotels. Choice may transfer personal information to Franchised Hotels as a part of administering the Choice Privileges program as outlined above. Choice processes Choice Privileges members’ personal information primarily in the United States.
E-folio -
​If you participate in the electronic billing e-folio program, your hotel bill will be sent to you over the Internet in an unsecure (unencrypted) manner – by email or through our mobile applications, depending on your preference and selection - and could be subject to interception by third parties. C
If you use a corporate credit card, billing information and the details of your hotel stay will be shared with the credit card provider who, in turn, will provide it to your employer. LI
Other uses of personal information -
​To serve you better, Choice may combine information you give us online, at Franchised Hotels, through the mail, or in any other way. When is personal information disclosed to others?
We need to transfer your information to Franchised Hotels, credit card issuers, and other companies where necessary to complete your transaction (e.g., secure your reservation with a Franchised Hotel, or to award Choice Privileges points). Please note that some hotels may be in countries other than your country of residence and may not provide an equivalent level of data protection. K
 
Choice distributes personal information about guests and Choice Privileges members to third party service providers such as web analytics companies, market researchers and fulfillment houses. We also use such third parties to:
conduct data processing for Choice; LI
engage in e-mail and direct mail communications on behalf of Choice; LI
administer sweepstakes and contests; LI
administer guest surveys; LI
compile information for us about the type and frequency of guest stays and the use of the Choice Privileges program by members; and LI
compile information for us about the use of Choice’s websites and mobile apps. LI
          These parties are contractually prohibited from using personal information for any purpose other than the purpose that Choice specifies.
Choice may also distribute personal information to airline and other companies upon request of guests, to allow guests to: (i) earn frequent customer miles/points with such airline and other companies for stays at hotels, or (ii) redeem Choice Privileges points for goods and services of such airline and other companies. C
 
Choice may partner with other companies to provide co-sponsored or co-branded promotions, sweepstakes, contests, products and services and may share your information with these companies. C
 
When using the Choice mobile app, your precise location may be shared with Choice business partners to make services or products available to you, such as food delivery or local entertainment. C
 
As available in specified regions, if you choose to apply for a Choice Privileges Visa card, you will be linked from Choice’s website to Barclays Bank Delaware’s website and will be required to enter certain personal information as part of the credit application process. Please refer to Barclays Bank Delaware’s privacy statement posted on their website to understand how the information you supply will be used. C
 
To the extent required or permitted by law, we may collect, use and disclose personal information in connection with security-related or law enforcement investigations or in the course of cooperating with authorities or complying with legal requirements. LO
 
We may also use your information as permitted by law to perform credit checks, report or collect debts owed, or protect the rights or property of Choice, our employees, our Franchised Hotels, our customers, this site, or its users. LI, LO

We may disclose your personal information to a third party in the event of any reorganization, merger, sale, joint venture, assignment, transfer or other disposition of all or any portion of our business, assets or stock (including in connection with any bankruptcy or similar proceedings). LI, LO

Does Choice process my personal information outside the European Economic Area?
Like most multi-national businesses, we have centralized certain aspects of our data processing, allowing us to better manage our business as a whole. That centralization will result in the transfer of personal information from one country to another. These countries may have data protection laws that are different to the laws of your country (and, in some cases, may not be as protective).

Our Website servers are located in the United States, and our group companies and third-party service providers and partners operate around the world. This means that when we collect your personal information we may process it globally.

To facilitate transferring European Economic Area (EEA) citizens’ personal information out of the EEA countries, Choice incorporates the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the EU Commission into applicable contract agreements to ensure that the necessary levels of protection and care are required of all parties. Information about the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses and a copy of the Standard Contractual Clauses can be found here. Additional information about Choice’s incorporation of the Standard Contractual Clauses in its contract agreements or the data protection measures associated with data transfers can be requested by sending us a request by letter or email to the address in the section of this notice.

What are my data rights?
Accessing personal information
With some limited exceptions, you have the right to access (i.e., view) the personal information we maintain about you by sending us a request by letter or email to the address in the section of this notice.

Restricting or objecting to processing
You have the right to request that we restrict or stop processing personal information that we hold about you by sending a letter or email to the address in the section of this notice. If we are unable to cease processing your personal information (e.g., because of a legal obligation), we will document that you made such a request and the reason we are unable to honor it.

Updating your personal information
You have the right to request the update or correction of the personal information we hold about you, where this is factually incorrect. If we agree the information is incorrect or that the processing can be stopped, we will correct the information or cease processing the information, as appropriate. If we do not agree that the personal information is incorrect, we will still record the fact that you consider the personal information to be incorrect in the relevant files(s). You can request updates to personal information that we hold about you by sending a letter or email to the address in the section of this notice.

Opting out of marketing communications or otherwise controlling privacy preferences
We respect the right of each visitor to control how his or her personal information is used. If you do not want us to provide your information to our business partners, or if you do not wish to receive promotional communications from us or our affiliates concerning special offers, discounts, airline bonuses, or contests, select one of the following options to provide us with your privacy preferences:

Click here if you have an online account and edit your privacy preferences within your account.

-OR-

If you do not have an online account and do not wish to create one, click here to provide us with your privacy preferences.

-OR-

For unsubscribing from marketing e-mails, use the “Unsubscribe” function in the e-mail you receive from us.

You can also request changes to your privacy preferences or unsubscribe from marketing e-mails by sending a letter or email to the address in the section of this notice.

Deleting personal information
You can request deletion of your personal information by sending a letter or email to the address in the section of this notice.

Data portability
Under the General Data Protection Regulation, EEA residents have the right to data portability. Choice satisfies this obligation by providing you access to the personal information we have about you in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format. You can also ask us to provide the information to another data controller. You can request your data by sending a letter or email to the address in the section of this notice.

Supervisory authorities
If you are unhappy with the resolution of your requests or complaints, you have the right to contact your local Data Protection Authority for assistance. The European Commission provides a list of the contact details of the National Data Protection Authorities, found here.

You also have the right under EU law not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, which may have a legal impact on you. Note that Choice does not currently perform automated processing that would affect individuals in this way.

With any request to exercise your data rights, be sure to include your name, address, e-mail address and Choice Privileges number (if applicable) so that we can confirm your identity and the personal information we maintain about you. We may not disclose data that you are not entitled to receive under applicable laws (e.g., data revealing information about another individual).

How do you store and secure my personal information?
Our reservation system and other databases are maintained in the United States; therefore, your personal information will be collected (or transferred) and maintained in the United States. We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect the personal information that we collect and process about you. The measures we use are designed to provide a level of security appropriate to the risk of processing your personal information.

For example, when you provide us with information through this site, such as your name, address, phone number, credit card information and room preference, your information will be encrypted using a Transport Layer Security connection. You can tell if your information is encrypted online by looking for the locked padlock icon on the lower right-hand or left-hand corner of your website screen and a change in the site address from “http” to “https.”

Do you use “cookies” and similar technologies?
Choice’s websites, mobile applications and e-mails may use “cookies” and other computer code processes. These are small amounts of computer code that interact with your computer, mobile device, browser or e-mail. The types of cookies Choice uses are referred to as “session” cookies and “persistent” cookies. Session cookies are temporary and are automatically deleted once you close your internet browser. Persistent cookies remain on your computer hard drive or mobile device until you delete them or are otherwise removed upon expiration. Cookies are required for the online reservation process so that we can keep your information on multiple pages throughout the booking process. Additionally, Choice uses cookies to remind us of who you are, tailor our services to suit your personal interests, track your status in our promotions, contests and sweepstakes, and/or analyze your visiting patterns.

Choice uses pixels or transparent GIF files to help manage its online advertising. These files enable Choice and its advertising partners to recognize unique codes on your web browser, which in turn, enable Choice to learn which advertisements bring users to its websites. The information that Choice collects and shares is anonymous and not directly identifiable. It does not contain your name, address, telephone number, or e-mail address.

The site may also include integrated social media tools or “plug-ins,” such as social networking tools offered by third parties, such as Facebook or Google. If you use these tools to share personal information or you otherwise interact with social media features on the site, those social media companies may collect information about you and may use and share such information in accordance with your account settings, including sharing such information with the general public. Your interactions with third-party social media companies and the use of their features are governed by the privacy notices of the social media companies that provide those features.

Do Not Track Signals: Some web browsers offer a “Do Not Track” (“DNT”) signal that is an HTTP header field indicating your preference regarding tracking or cross-site user tracking. We currently do not recognize DNT signals; however, we do allow you to exercise some choice in the information collected by adjusting your browser’s cookie settings.

You can generally set your browser to not accept cookies or to notify you when you are sent a cookie, giving you the chance to decide whether or not to accept it. Not accepting cookies will adversely affect your ability to perform certain transactions and functions on Choice websites.

If you would like to know more about cookies, the website www.allaboutcookies.org provides useful information.

Click here for additional information about the cookies used on this site.

Google Analytics
This website uses Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google, Inc. (“Google”). Google Analytics uses “cookies”, which are text files placed on your computer, to help analyze how users use the site. The information generated by the cookie about your use of the website (including your Internet Protocol (IP) address) will be transmitted to and stored by Google on servers in the United States. Because of the present activation of the IP anonymization, Google will truncate/anonymize the IP address within the area of the European Union or a member state of the Agreement on the European Economic Area. On behalf of the website provider, Google will use this information for the purpose of evaluating your use of the website, compiling reports on website activity for website operators and providing other services relating to website activity and internet usage to the website provider. Google will not associate your IP address with any other data held by Google.

You can prevent Google’s collection and use of data (cookies and IP address) by downloading and installing the browser plug-in available under https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

Further information concerning Google’s data privacy and terms of use can be found here.

Please note that on this website, Google Analytics code is supplemented by “anonymizeIp();” to ensure an anonymized collection of IP addresses (so called IP-masking).

Choice partners with third party ad networks to either display advertising on Choice websites or to manage its advertising on other sites. These companies may collect information about your activity on our sites and your interaction with our advertising and other communications and use this information to determine which ads you see on third party websites and applications. If you would like more information about this practice, and to understand your options, please visit www.aboutads.info.

Do you use my device’s geo-location data?
Our mobile apps may use your device’s Global Positioning System (GPS) or other technology to locate a hotel near you and/or to provide you with other relevant location-based information and/or services. Your location may be shared with Choice business partners to make services or products available to you, such as food delivery or local entertainment. Business partners who have access to your precise and/or general location information may use the information only in support of Choice’s purposes described in this Notice.

To the extent any geo-location data is combined with personal information, that information will be treated as personal information in accordance with this Notice.

How long do you keep my personal information?
Your personal information related to a reservation or stay will be stored by us for the period of time required by law in the jurisdiction of the Franchised Hotel to which the information relates or for a longer period if there is a legitimate business purpose for doing so. Your personal information collected for other uses will be retained for the period necessary for the purposes set out in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law or there is a business purpose for doing so.

What if I apply for a career at Choice Hotels?
If you apply online for employment at Choice, you may be asked to provide us your name, address, e-mail and resume. Choice will use this information solely with respect to your job search and to determine your qualifications for a career with Choice.

Does this notice cover other sites linked from this website or Choice’s mobile apps?
Choice is only responsible for the privacy and security notice and content on this website and Choice’s mobile apps. This website and our mobile apps may redirect to third-party websites and mobile apps. Those websites and mobile apps are not covered by this Notice, and we are not responsible for the privacy practices or the content of those websites and mobile apps.

Does this notice cover other sites linked from this website or Choice’s mobile apps?
Choice is only responsible for the privacy and security notice and content on this website and Choice’s mobile apps. This website and our mobile apps may redirect to third-party websites and mobile apps. Those websites and mobile apps are not covered by this Notice, and we are not responsible for the privacy practices or the content of those websites and mobile apps.

What about changes to the privacy and security notice?
Choice reserves the right to modify this Notice and related business practices at any time by posting updated text on this site. Please review the “last updated” at the top of the Notice to see when this privacy notice was last revised. If we make a material change we will post a notice on our website at least 30 calendar days prior to its implementation.

How do you resolve complaints?
We will work with you to address complaints, which may include contacting applicable authorities as part of the resolution process.

What if there's a difference between versions of the Privacy and Security Policy?
As a service to our customers, we make this Notice available in several different languages. In the event of any discrepancies between the various translations of the notice, the English version of the Notice is the authoritative one.

Who is the data controller?
With respect to the personal information we collect, use, disclose, store, delete, protect, or receive from Franchised Hotels, Choice Hotels International, Inc. is a data controller as defined under the General Data Protection Regulation. See for information about Franchised Hotels as data controllers.

Children's privacy
Our websites are not intended for children and we do not knowingly solicit or collect personal information for persons under the age of 18.

How do I contact the Data Protection Officer?
If you have questions about this notice, concerns or complaints about how we collect, use, disclose, store, delete, or protect your personal information, Choice’s Data Protection Officer can be reached at:
Choice Hotels International
Attn: Data Protection Officer
18615 Claret Drive,
Scottsdale, AZ 85255.

The aim of this privacy policy is to provide an overview of the privacy practices exercised by M2Catalyst, LLC (“M2,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), with respect to our Services (services offered by us including our mobile applications, websites, and related services), unless the terms and conditions or privacy policy accompanying an individual Service indicate otherwise. M2Catalyst is the data controller for the personal data collected through its Services.

​

We want you to understand our policies and practices when it comes to how we collect, use, and share your information. Your privacy is important to us. We are dedicated to protecting your personal information and informing you about how we use it.

​

By using any of our Services, you hereby agree with the practices set out in this Privacy Policy.

 

What information does M2 obtain and how is it used?
​

Information You Provide

​

Some of our Services require you to provide us with personal information such as your name and email address when you choose to contact us. We require this information in order to respond to your inquiries. IP address may be collected from website logging. Name, email address and external IP address are not collected automatically from any of our mobile applications.

​

Collected Information

​

We gather certain information either automatically or based on permission settings in our mobile applications. Such information includes, but is not limited to, the model of mobile device you use, your device location, the mobile network (mobile carrier) you use, your mobile network information, language, and Wi-Fi network information. Privacy policy
Last changed: 27 Feb 2023

Skippo AB, organization number 559386-0942 (hereinafter referred to as ”Skippo”), is a company with operations in the Nordic region. Within Skippo we process personal data for our customers, their representatives and contact persons as well as users who use our services and products. Skippo’s privacy policy has been developed with the aim of maintaining a high level of protection for personal privacy and to clarify skippo’s position on privacy issues and the processing of personal data. Through this Policy, and in accordance with applicable legislation, including the General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679, ”GDPR”) and other applicable national data protection laws in Sweden (”Data Protection Legislation”), we ensure the privacy of our customers and users. This Privacy Policy applies to all products and services provided by Skippo, including websites and mobile applications. However, certain products and services provided by Skippo may be subject to special conditions regarding the processing of personal data. You will be informed of these in the event of use of the relevant service / product.

1. Summary of our data processing practices
Skippo collects personal data for the purpose of, among other things, communicating with, and fulfilling our commitments towards, our customers and users in accordance with the agreements we have entered into and to improve the quality of our products and services. We also collect personal data in order to offer you customized content and ads. In addition, personal data is collected for the purpose of providing and administering your access to services as well as responding to customer service cases and correcting errors. Skippo only processes your personal data for the purposes for which it was collected and in accordance with this privacy policy and relevant legislation. We save personal data for as long as it is required to fulfill the purposes described in this privacy policy. When your personal data is no longer relevant for the purposes for which it was collected, we delete or anonymise it, including any logs and other backups.

2. Legal bases
Your personal integrity is important to Skippo and we only process your personal data in accordance with relevant privacy legislation. We process your personal data when it is required to fulfill an agreement with you and process customer cases and services provided by Skippo’s customer service. We also process your personal data when we have a legitimate interest, such as directing marketing directly to you. When required, we will ask for your consent.

3. What data is collected and for what purpose?
Personalized and relevant advertising
Our products and services contain personalized content. Such information are provided by Skippo, our customers and partners. Against this background, we may collect information about how you as a user use our products and services in order to show you customized content. We can also create this opportunity for our partners. Skippo also uses the combination of databases during data processing to be able to profile the information provided to the users. The information is processed on the basis of legitimate interest, GDPR 6 (1) (f), and the information is deleted twelve months after the information is collected. You can say no to Skippo processing your data to personalize ads on our websites by changing the settings for the cookie policy. To say no to personalized content: go into the sidebar and check off for Allow tracking.

Direct marketing
Skippo uses personal data for direct marketing in accordance with applicable legislation. This means that we contact you as a recipient directly, instead of through mass communicative means, with the intention of obtaining a response from you. We may also provide such personal data to our partners who wish to offer you direct marketing. In some cases, personal data is processed for the purpose of offering services other than Skippo’s own. In such cases, Skippo may process personal data for, and in accordance with the instructions from, third parties, such as our partners. The information is processed on the basis of legitimate interest, GDPR 6 (1) (f), and the information is deleted twelve months after the information is collected.

Statistical
For statistical purposes, Skippo may collect information about how you as a user use our products and services in order to analyze your behavior. Skippo may also collect information about market trends in order to determine future demand for the development of our products and services. The information is processed on the basis of legitimate interest, GDPR 6 (1) (f), and the information is deleted three years and one month after the information is collected. Data is also collected to improve our products and services, make them more user-friendly, check that they work correctly, and provide information about outages. Such information is collected, for example, with the help of Google analytics, Google Firebase Crashlytics and Facebook, as well as with the help of cookies that do not contain personal data. You can find more information about cookies and how you can block them in our Cookie Policy. We also use IP addresses to, for example, enable us to diagnose problems in our servers, networks and to administer our websites, as well as for statistical purposes.

Your electronic equipment
Skippo collects information about your electronic equipment, such as mobile, computer and tablet, as well as about your internet connection. This information includes those generated by service logs and other tools, including your operating system, browser version, IP address, cookies, and unique identifiers. We do this to improve personalized offers to customers and users. The information is processed on the basis of legitimate interest, GDPR 6 (1) (f), and the information is deleted three years and one month after the information is collected.

Prevention of addiction
In order to prevent, limit and investigate various forms of abuse of, and illegal activities on the internet, we use personal data about users’ activities and electronic equipment. Abuse of the internet refers to, for example, ID hijacking, fraud and harassment. The information is processed on the basis of legitimate interest, GDPR 6 (1) (f), and the information is deleted three years and one month after the information is collected.

Consent to the processing of personal data
When there is a legal requirement to obtain your consent to process certain types of personal data, or to a certain type of processing, such consent is obtained from you prior to the processing of the personal data. The information is processed with the support of consent, GDPR 6 (1) (a), and is saved for as long as necessary for the purpose, see above, or until you withdraw your consent.

Sensitive information and persons under the age of 13
We never collect or process personal data that may be considered sensitive, such as information about your health. Our services are not intended for use by persons under the age of 13 and skippo does not intentionally collect personal data about anyone under this age limit. If you find out that your child has provided personal information to us without your consent, please contact us at dataprotectionoffice@skippo.io.

Facebook
By posting updates and comments on Facebook (”Facebook Information”), you enable skippo to process and share such Facebook information in accordance with this Privacy Policy. The information is processed on the basis of legitimate interest, GDPR 6 (1) (f), and the information is deleted three years and one month after the information is collected.

Location-based services
In order to offer you location-based products and services, Skippo may collect, use and store precise location data, including real-time geographic location of your computer or device. We use various technologies to track the location, such as GPS, Bluetooth and your IP address as well as wifi hotspots and cell tower location. This data helps us, for example, to offer you searches based on your location, real-time traffic information and directions, as well as the ability to provide you with information and offers from us or our partners. When you use the Tracking Plotter or Anchor Guard functions in Skippo services, the app retrieves location information even when the app is running in the background. The information is processed on the basis of legitimate interest, GDPR 6 (1) (f), and the information is deleted three years and one month after the information is collected.

4. Transfer of personal data to our partners (third parties)
Transfer
Skippo may transfer personal data to subcontractors if we deem it necessary to fulfill our commitments to you as a customer or user. Our subcontractors must always enter into agreements on the processing of personal data with Skippo to ensure a high level of protection for your personal data.

Our partners
Skippo may provide information about your behavior within our services and products to our partners. We may also provide such data to our partners in order to demonstrate the interest in a particular advertisement or campaign. We do not disclose personal data to third parties unless required by applicable law. However, your personal data may be transferred and processed by third-party suppliers who perform services for Skippo (personal data assistants) to enable these companies to perform the services ordered by Skippo. Only the personal data needed to fulfill the above purposes is disclosed to the companies. All third-party suppliers must comply with our instructions and applicable Personal Data Assistant Agreements as well as any other agreements that apply between Skippo and the third-party suppliers. Companies must also put in place appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data.

Public authorities
Skippo may disclose personal data to a third party such as the police or other public authority during a criminal investigation or if Skippo is otherwise obliged to disclose such information by law or decision of a public authority.

5. Security and privacy
Websites owned and controlled by Skippo have a high level of security that aims to protect the personal data under Skippo’s control. Skippo only processes personal data for the purposes for which it was collected and as stated above. Personal data is only available to authorised employees who hold a position that requires them to process personal data in order to carry out their work. Personal data is not processed longer than is required for the purpose in question. We comply with legal obligations and our internal retention guidelines. Skippo has taken appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data so that only authorized persons have access to the personal data. We have also introduced internal guidelines to protect the processing of personal data.

6. Where is your data processed?
We mainly process personal data on servers within the EU/EEA. We may need to transfer your data to a location outside the EU/EEA. The level of protection of personal data in countries outside the EU/EEA may be lower than within the EU/EEA and if this is the case, we take appropriate measures under the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) to ensure that your personal data remains safe and protected. Our international transfers of personal data are based on the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses, which you can find here.

7. External links
Skippo’s websites and mobile apps may contain links to external websites or services that are not controlled by Skippo. If you click on a link to an external website, we recommend that you read the information on the processing of personal data and the use of cookies that applies to the external website.

8. What are your rights and choices?
We have a legal obligation to ensure that your information is stored correctly and is up to date. We encourage you to help us meet this obligation by ensuring that you inform us of any changes to your information/preferences by contacting us at customer service.
You can exercise your rights at any time regarding the personal data we process about you:

The right of access and rectification: You have the right to request access to the personal data concerning you. This includes, for example, the right to be informed about whether or not personal data is processed about you, what personal data is processed and the purpose of the processing. You also have the right to request that incorrect or incomplete personal data be corrected.
Right to object: You have the right to object to certain processing of personal data, such as the processing of your personal data for marketing purposes or when we otherwise base our processing of your personal data on a legitimate interest.
Right to erasure: You can request that your personal data be deleted if, for example, the data is no longer required for the purposes for which it was collected, if the processing is unlawful or if the personal data must be deleted in order for us to comply with a legal requirement.
Right to data portability: Personal data about you that you have provided yourself, which is automatically processed with your consent or in accordance with an agreement between you and Skippo as a data controller, you can request to be disclosed in a structured, generally usable and machine-readable format. You can also request that the personal data be transferred to another data controller, if this is technically possible.
Right to withdraw your consent: In cases where the processing is based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw your consent to the processing at any time.
Right to opt out of future marketing: You have the option to opt out of future marketing each time we send you marketing materials. You can also opt out at any time by contacting us.
If you wish to lodge a complaint with a national supervisory authority about our processing of your personal data, you can do so by contacting your local data protection authority (by ”local” means where you live or work, or where the alleged infringement was committed). The relevant authority is the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (www.imy.se).

9. Changes to the Privacy Policy
This privacy policy is subject to change. We therefore recommend that you visit this page regularly to read the latest version of the privacy policy. The date of the latest version is displayed at the top of the privacy policy.

10. Contact us
If you have any questions about our data protection policy, please contact Skippo’s customer service. support@skippo.io

Data Retention

Changes in this Privacy Statement
