PRIVACY POLICY – KIKA KEYBOARD

Privacy Policy

KIKA TECH, INC. provides this Privacy Policy to help you understand how we collect, use and disclose information, including what you may provide to us or that we obtain from our products and services. We treat your privacy very seriously.

Information Collection & Usage

We collect the following information to provide you an enhanced user experience and better services as well as to improve our products.


I. Product Metrics

We collect data about how you and your device interact with our products. This includes (1) device information such as manufacturer, model, OS version, language settings, nation settings and applications installed, (2) data regarding our application such as version and installation source, and (3) your interaction data such as views, duration of stay at views, transition from view to view and how you enter and leave the view. The data collected helps us know which functions you like and which functions to improve. This information allows us to improve our products and provide you a better user experience. All data is encrypted before being stored locally or transferred to our servers for analysis. Only authorized personnel can access the summarized data with the original data regarding your interactions destroyed periodically.

II. Feedback Data

We use Zendesk as the feedback platform as we recognize your trust and suggestions make us better. This platform allows our well trained support team members to interact with you. We collect the content of messages you send to us, such as feedback, questions or information you provide for customer support. When you contact us for customer support, phone conversations or chat sessions with our representatives may be monitored and recorded.

III. Crash Data

We use Google Fabric to collect crash data from some users. This helps us improve our products and services for all users.

IV. The Installed App List

To avoid showing the same notification twice to you, we use the installed App list, locally, to check if there are the similar themes in the system. The information of installed themes might be encrypted and sent to the server.
Data Protection

All data stored in your device and transmitted to our cloud services from our application is encrypted with access restricted for the usage stated in this document.

Data Sharing

We do not sell any data to third parties. We may share data with third parties to improve your user experience.

Change of Control

If we sell or otherwise transfer our products or our assets to another organizations, data received from or about our users may be among the items sold or transferred. Any buyer or transferee will be required to honor the commitments made in this Privacy Policy.

Changes to this Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes to our information practices. If we make any material changes we will notify users by means of a notice on our website prior to the change becoming effective. We encourage you to periodically review this page for the latest information on our privacy practices.

Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, you may contact us at support@kikakeyboard.com or write to us at: 8 N. San Pedro Street, Suite 230, San Jose, CA 95110, USA.

Your choices and selecting your communication preferences

By following the instructions included in each promotional email from us to unsubscribe from that mailing
By completing and submitting this form or by contacting us via mail at: Cisco Systems, Inc., Privacy Office, 170 West Tasman Dr., San Jose, CA 95134, USA. Disclosing your Personal Data

Within Cisco and any of our worldwide subsidiaries for the purposes of data processing, such as marketing, business operations, compliance, security, website or Solution functionality, or storage
With business partners, service vendors, authorized third-party agents, or contractors to provide a requested website, Solution, service, or transaction. With Cisco business partners or vendors, so that they may share information with you about their products or services. To opt out of Cisco sharing with third parties for their marketing purposes, please submit a Privacy Request.
In connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, consolidation or restructuring, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by or to another company

In aggregated, anonymized, and/or de-identified form that cannot reasonably be used to identify you
If we otherwise notify you and you consent to the sharing
Security of your Personal Data
We take reasonable and appropriate steps to protect the Personal Data entrusted to us and treat it securely in accordance with this Privacy Statement. Cisco implements physical, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect your Personal Data from accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, and unauthorized disclosure or access. We also contractually require that our suppliers protect such information from accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure, or access.

Retention and disposal of Personal Data

We will not retain Personal Data in identifiable form when the purpose(s) for which the Personal Data was collected have been achieved and there is no legal or business need to retain such Personal Data. Use of cookies and similar technologies
Cisco uses automatic data collection tools, such as cookies, embedded web links, pixels, tags, and web beacons. These tools collect certain standard information that your browser sends to us (such as Internet Protocol [IP] address, MAC address, clickstream behavior, and telemetry).

SPOTSEE.IO’S PRIVACY STATEMENT
Your right to privacy is very important.  ShockWatch, Inc. dba SpotSee (“SpotSee”) recognizes that when you choose to provide us with information about yourself, you trust us to act responsibly.  That is why we endeavor to use the information we collect and process carefully and sensibly, and have taken steps to safeguard it.

This Privacy Statement addresses how we collect and use information you provide to us.  Specifically, this statement addresses:

The definition of “Personal Data”
The Personal Data we collect and how we collect it
Our use of cookies, similar technologies, and analytics.
Our sharing of Personal Data
How we protect your Personal Data
Marketing and the right to opt out
How you can update or correct Personal Data
Retention of Personal Data
Your choices
Other websites
Children

“Do Not Track” signals
European Union/European Economic Area Users

Changes to the Privacy Statement
Please read this Privacy Statement and our Terms and Conditions carefully before using the website. 

THE DEFINITION OF “PERSONAL DATA”

In this Privacy Statement, we define “Personal Data” broadly as any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. Personal Data includes, among other things, your name, address, telephone number, and may also include your IP address.

THE PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT AND HOW WE COLLECT IT

Although we engage in business to business (“B2B”) transactions, we may collect information about individuals employed by or otherwise representing our business customers.  We may obtain information from individuals in the following ways:  (1) when you voluntarily provide us with the information by completing an on-line form; (2) automatically when you visit our websites; (3) when you provide us with information by email, mail, fax, or telephone; (4) when you provide us with information in person; or (5) when we receive information about you from our marketing partners.

We will not, however, collect any information directly identifying an individual —such as name, address, e-mail address, and phone number—from visits to our website unless you voluntarily provide it.  Ultimately, it is your choice whether to provide us with this information.

Information Provided Voluntarily.  Depending on the information and/or services you request, SpotSee may ask you to provide your name, email address, employer, job title, and other information at certain points throughout our website.   More specifically, SpotSee may collect the following:

Information that you provide when you complete forms on our website to use our services (for example to receive information from us or our authorized distributors), posting material, or requesting further information.  We may also ask you for information when you enter a competition or promotion online and when you report a problem with our site. We will use this information to provide you with any requested services and to market our services.
Any username or login you set up to access the SpotSee Cloud.
If you contact us, we may keep a record of that correspondence.
Information you choose to provide in response to surveys we use for research purposes. You do not have to respond to these surveys.
Information Collected Automatically Through Website Visits.  If you are only browsing our website, we will not ask you for any information directly identifying you, but certain information—including your computer and connection information, browser type (e.g., Chrome, Edge or Internet Explorer) and version, operating system (e.g., Windows or Macintosh) and platform details, and the domain name from which you accessed the website (e.g., google.com or yahoo.com)—may be automatically collected.

In addition, we may collect information about your browsing behavior, such as the date and time you visit our website, the areas or pages of our website that you visit, the amount of time spent viewing our website, the number of times you return to our website, and other click-stream data.  We may use cookies to collect this information, which may be combined with any information you have provided us that directly identifies you.  This information helps us to improve our website and to deliver a better and more personalized service to you.

From Third Parties.  We work with advertising partners that may collect Personal Data about you when you fill out a form to download information about our products and services or otherwise request information about our products and services.  We do not receive your Personal Data if you choose to opt out and not have that data shared with us.

OUR USE OF COOKIES, SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES, AND ANALYTICS

Some SpotSee sites, like many other commercial web sites, uses cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies, to collect information about how you use our site in order to enhance your viewing experience.  A cookie is a piece of data that our website automatically transfers to the hard drive of your PC or mobile device when your browser accesses our website.  Cookies were designed to help a website operator determine that a particular user had visited the site previously and thus save and remember any preferences that may have been set while the user was browsing the site.  Cookies cannot retrieve any other data from your hard drive or obtain your e-mail address.  If you are simply browsing a SpotSee informational site, a cookie may be used to identify your browser as one that has visited the site before.

You can find out more about this type of technology through your internet browser.

Most browsers are initially set up to accept cookies.  You may refuse to accept cookies by changing the settings on your browser.  Your browser will tell you in simple terms how to do this, usually through a ‘help’ section on most browser toolbars.  However, some features or services on our sites may not function properly without cookies.

We may use web beacons to assist us in understanding how visitors to our websites use such sites and/or to collect information regarding user’s activities on the web.  Web beacons are similar but not identical to cookies in the way they operate.  You can find out more about web beacons at various internet sites.  We may also use the services of a third party to collect such information for us.

Cookies and similar technologies allow us to:

Improve, enhance, and refine the quality of the website’s services and better understand your needs;
Provide you information to allow you to maneuver around the website more effectively and efficiently;
Communicate with you;
Manage the website, monitor traffic patterns, and gauge service popularity;
Carry out our marketing activities;
Respond to your requests for customer service;
Recognize you when you return to our website; and
Provide you with targeted advertising.
We may occasionally carry out market research, provide targeted advertising, and otherwise engage in business development activities.  Third parties, including AdRoll and Google, might help us to do this and they use cookies, web beacons, or similar technologies. Those third parties may collect Personal Data to target advertising on other sites or applications based on the site user’s online activity.

You may opt out of receiving targeted advertisements by visiting the NAI website opt out page here: https://www.networkadvertising.org/choices/ or the DAA opt out page here: https://www.aboutads.info/.  If you are a user in the European Union, you may opt out of targeted advertising by visiting the EDAA opt out page here:  https://youronlinechoices.eu/.   If you would like to opt out of Google’s use of cookies please visit Google’s Ads Settings.

We also use Google Analytics, a web analysis service of Google, Inc., to improve the user experience. Google Analytics helps us determine the number of visitors to our website and helps us understand how users find our site. Google Analytics may record your geographical location, device, internet browser, operating system, and IP address. To learn more about how Google Analytics collects and processes data, please visit www.google.com/policies/privacy/partners/.  If you do not want to be tracked by Google Analytics on our website, you can opt out at https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

HOW WE USE YOUR PERSONAL DATA

We may use the Personal Data we collect from you for any of the following purposes:

To provide you with personalized content that is presented in the most effective manner for you and for your computer;

SpotSee retains the right to use Aggregated Data for internal use and to distribute and share any Aggregated Data with others on a selective basis.

OUR SHARING OF PERSONAL DATA

When it is necessary to process your request, including requests for goods, services, support or additional information. In such instances we may share your information with a trusted business partner who is subject to agreements that oblige them to process such information only on our instructions and in compliance with this Privacy Statement and appropriate confidentiality and security measures.
If we have your permission.
To respond to the judicial process and provide information to law enforcement agencies. In those cases, SpotSee will, of its own discretion, either comply with the request/order or seek protection from it.
If we believe the release is reasonably necessary to comply with the law; enforce our Terms and Conditions; or to protect the rights, property, or safety of SpotSee, our users, or the public.

HOW WE PROTECT YOUR PERSONAL DATA

Once we receive your transmission, we will use our security procedures to try to prevent unauthorized access.

the nature of your request;
that the request is related to “Your California Privacy Rights;”
your name, street address, city, state, zip code and email address; and
whether you prefer to receive a response to your request by mail or email.

Privacy Policy
This Privacy Statement informs you (“You”) a user of the Company Website, senza.us (the “Website”) and mobile applications (“Apps”) about how 527H, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Company” or “we”) gathers and uses Your personal information submitted to Company and aggregated information collected from the Websites, Apps and Services. This Privacy Policy applies to the Websites and Apps and other Company-owned services, applications and products which link to this policy (“Services”). From time to time we may update this Privacy Policy. Your use of any of the Services after an updated Privacy Policy becomes effective will indicate Your acceptance.

Collection of Personal Information
Use of Personal Information
Sharing Information with Friends and in User Forums
Control of Personal Information and Opt-Out Options
Security of Information We Collect
Protection of Children's Privacy
Use of Cookies and Tracking Technology
Enforcement of This Statement
Links to Other Websites
Users from Outside the United States
DO NOT TRACK DISCLOSURE
Contact Information
 

1. Collection of Personal Information
Company collects and uses Your personal information to manage and enhance Your use and experience of the Websites and Apps and Services. Company does not share with any third party information collected from You that could personally identify You, unless You specifically consent to such sharing. We may share information that we collect with third parties as provided for herein. However, without Your consent, such shared information will be aggregated or modified so that You will not be identified with such information.

We may also use and allow third parties to track Your browsing history profile. Such tracking will allow Company to offer You specifically tailored services and products (both of Company and its third party partners). No personally identifiable information will be shared with any third party without Your consent.

Types of Information Collected:

User Information. In addition to the above personal information, we collect standard information about Company users such as:

“Personal Diet Data,” including birthdate, height and weight, gender, heart rate related data and specific details of the foods and drinks that You consume and Your exercise
Email address and Company password
IP addresses, browser type and Your operating system
Pages visited on the Websites referring and exit pages, and the dates and times of the visits
Financial information, such as Your credit/debit card number or other billing information for purchases and product upgrades
Any additional information relating to You and Your use of the Websites, App or Services that You provide to use directly through the Websites or the App
Location data and other information about devices used to access and interact with the Websites or App
Information that You make publicly available or publicly post using tools made available on the Websites or via the App
Information You may provide in user-to-user messages
Information collected from promotions with third-party companies.
Supplemental Information. Your information also may be supplemented with additional information from other sources, including publicly available sources.

2. Use of Personal Information
Without Your permission, we will not share Your information with third parties. We may share information collected from You that does not identify You or an individual with third parties, including advertisers and potential business partners such as anonymized data or aggregated data and statistics. For example, we may disclose the total number of pounds lost by all Company users, the average weight loss of Company users, or generalized information about diet and exercise habits based on aggregated statistics developed from collected data.

We also may share such anonymized and aggregated data:

To fulfill the services and products You request from us.
To operate and improve the Websites, App and Services available to You through the Company, including developing new features and products.
To communicate with You, respond to Your requests and manage our relationship.
To personalize the products and services provide to You.
Measure performance of the products and Services.
To allow You to participate in Challenges, contests and surveys. Company may co-sponsor promotions with other companies, in which case any information collected is likely to be shared with other participating sponsors.
To send You marketing notices including promotions of our products and services. You can opt-out of communications from Company at any time (see control of personal information below).
For internal purposes, which may require the transfer of such information to other Company affiliates for administrative purposes, for technical maintenance purposes, the marketing and promotion of products and services that might be of interest to You. 
We may disclose Your personal information when we reasonably believe that it is required by a law or legal process and to protect and defend the rights and interests of Company, its affiliates, suppliers, or users. If Company goes through a business transition, such as a merger, being acquired by another company, or selling a portion of its assets, users' personal information and Personal Diet Data will, in most instances, be part of the assets transferred.

Please note that if You use any Websites or App tools to disclose information about Yourself (for example, in chat rooms, user-to-user messaging or online message boards), others outside of Company may obtain access to information You provide.

In some circumstances we may use third-party contractors to perform these services on our behalf. In such circumstances, we will only provide the contractor with the information needed to perform the services (for example, name and address if a contractor is delivering a product to You), and all contractors will be required to agree to confidentiality obligations with respect to Your personal, non-public information.

3. Sharing Information with Friends and in User Forums
The Services allow You to share Your diet and exercise goals and information with friends that You select.

In addition, if You accept an invitation from an Advisor, You will enable the sharing of Your Personal Diet Data information and potentially personally identifiable information with the Advisor. 

Please bear in mind that Company cannot control what Your friends or Advisor do with the information You share with them, so You should only share with friends and an Advisor You trust.

 

4. Control of Personal information and Opt-Out Options
Company values the accuracy of the information You provide. You can confirm, change, or update personal information You have provided to us by contacting us directly at privacy@senza.us. If You change Your mind, You can opt-in again, by emailing this same address. When You opt-out of promotional communications from us, You may still receive service messages (such as an order confirmation) and legally mandated notices.

 

5. Security of the Information We Collect
We use a range of technologies and procedures to protect Your personal information. For example, we store personal information and Personal Diet Information in a secure, limited-access facility, and we use industry-standard firewalls and security software design to protect the security and integrity of Your Personal Diet Information.

 

6. Protection of Children's Privacy
527h.net  is a general interest website, and we do not knowingly collect any personal information from children. If You are under 18, You are not permitted to use the Services. Consistent with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (“COPPA”), the Services are not intended for use by anyone under the age of 18. Company does not knowingly collect personal information from children through the Services. 

If You are a parent with concerns about children's privacy issues in conjunction with the use of this Web Site, please contact us at privacy@senza.us.

 

7. Use of Cookies and Tracking Technology
7.1           Cookies. When You visit the Websites, a cookie may be saved on Your computer (if Your computer accepts cookies), and if You return to the Websites the cookie may be read. A “cookie” is a small text file placed on the user's hard drive to track usage of the Websites and collect basic information, which may include certain of Your preferences. We use cookies to gain knowledge of Internet usage, improve content and advertisements, collect the site visitation data described above, and in some cases to deliver specialized content. Cookies also help to prevent You from having to register or re-enter Your information every time You visit the Website in a streamlined fashion. Some of our advertisers and partners occasionally use cookies as well. Company does not have any control over the cookies used by advertisers and partners. If You would like to avoid cookies, Your web browser may have an option that enables You to disable or not accept cookies. It should be noted, however, that should You disable or not accept cookies, portions of the Web Site may not properly function.

7.2           Web Beacons. We may also use web beacons, clear gif technology, or action tags as mechanisms to collect aggregate site visitation data by tracking how users navigate to and through the Website. We may also use this technology to track the delivery of HTML email messages. Data collected through this mechanism is not linked to personal information. A web beacon is an electronic image and string of code that is imbedded in a web page or email which allows us to track web page views/hits or the opening of an email containing a beacon. We may use web beacons in conjunction with cookies to track activity on the Website. Web beacon tracking by Company does not identify the name or email address of the web user or mail recipient.

 

8. Mobile Analytics 
In addition, if You are using the App, Company or our partners may use analytics technology to track anonymous traffic data about use of the application. Such partners have the right to retain and use the anonymous traffic data collected by the analytics service from users of the Websites or the App.

 

9. Links to Other Websites
Our Websites may contain links to other websites. Please be aware that we are not responsible for the privacy practices of these other sites, and we encourage You to review the policies of each site You use. We cannot control the actions of such third parties or be held responsible for their use of any information that You provide directly to them.

 

10. Users from Outside the United States
Company and the Company servers are located in the United States and are subject to the applicable state and federal laws of the United States. If You use Company, You consent to the use and disclosure of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy and subject to such laws.

 

11. DO NOT TRACK DISCLOSURE
Company does not track its customers over time and across third-party websites to provide targeted advertising and therefore does not respond to Do Not Track (DNT) signals. However, some third-party sites do keep track of Your browsing activities when they serve You content, which enables them to tailor what they present to You. If You are visiting such sites, Your browser may be able to set the DNT signal so that third parties (particularly advertisers) know You do not want to be tracked.

Third parties that have content embedded on the Website or App such as a social feature may set cookies on a user's browser and/or obtain information about the fact that a web browser visited the Website from a certain IP address. Third parties cannot collect any other personally identifiable information from the Website unless You provide it to them directly.

 

12. Contact Information
We welcome Your input on our privacy statement. If You have any questions or suggestions regarding our privacy statement, please contact us at privacy@senza.us.

INTERACT Technology Privacy Policy

The Essentials

About this Policy
The Policy sets out how we collect, use and disclose your Personal Information.

About INTERACT Technology
We own and operate myINTERACT, a unique platform that consolidates, filters and unlocks the power of digital to bring efficiencies to all stakeholders in healthcare. The outcome is improved patient care. 

INTERACT’s Licensed Providers are the companies, groups, associations, and individuals that use INTERACT to publish to an audience. 

How does myINTERACT collect my Personal Information?
We collect your Personal Information when you share it with us through the platform or our website. 

What Personal Information does myINTERACT collect about me?
We collect your name and email address as well as details relating to your occupation and areas of interest. We also collect technical and behavioural information from you when you use myINTERACT. 

How is my Personal Information being used?
We mainly use your information to offer myINTERACT and our associated services to you. We may also use your information to develop and improve the app and to provide technical support.

How does myINTERACT disclose my Personal Information?
We may disclose your information to our partners, Licensed Providers, or where we are required by law. We do not sell Personal Information, or productise data in any way, nor do we share your information without your express consent.

How do I maintain or correct my Personal Information?
You can manage your Personal Information directly through the functionality provided on the platform or by contacting us at privacy@interact.technology. You can also reach out to Licensed Provider administrators. 

How does myINTERACT keep my Personal Information secure?
We implement strict technical and procedural controls to protect your data from unauthorised access or disclosure.

When is my Personal Information deleted?
We delete your information when it is no longer required for the purpose it was collected, or when a request is made for the data to be removed/deleted. 

How does myINTERACT deal with data breaches?
We will notify you and the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner of any unauthorised use or disclosure of data and will take steps to remedy any data breach.

Who do I contact if I want to make a complaint?
You can contact privacy@interact.technology if you have any questions, complaints or feedback about your Personal Information or how we manage Personal Information. If you are not satisfied with our response you can also contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner. 

  

About this Policy

This Privacy Policy sets out the way in which we collect and handle Personal Information.

We may amend or update this Policy from time to time. If this happens, we will publish any updates on our app and notify you by email or by posting a notice of the changes in the platform. If you do not agree with the changes, you must cease accessing myINTERACT. If you continue to access or use the platform after the changes come into effect, we will assume that you have agreed to them.

If you are visiting from the European Union or other regions with laws governing data collection and use, please note that you are agreeing to the transfer of your Personal Information to Australia and the United States to us. By providing your Personal Information, you consent to any transfer and processing in accordance with this Policy.

 

About INTERACT Technology

INTERACT Technology owns and operates myINTERACT platform. 

myINTERACT is a digital communication platform that aims to transform the way life science organisations and healthcare groups engage healthcare professionals and patients. The platform uses a combination of push and pull mechanisms to alert healthcare professionals’ attention to valued updates.  

INTERACT’s Licensed Providers are the companies, groups, associations, and individuals that use INTERACT to publish Content to an audience. You may be invited to receive Content from one, or over time, multiple Licensed Providers in your use of our platform. 

Information about who the Licensed Provider is, and their individual policies, can be found in the Licensed Provider’s privacy contact details. It is your choice as to which Licensed Providers you wish to engage with using myINTERACT; at any time you can choose to cancel that connection.

This Privacy Policy applies to the information we obtain when you access myINTERACT (as a downloadable app and/or SaaS product) via your device or when you otherwise interact with us.

This Policy does not apply to third party products or services that Licensed Providers may choose to integrate with the INTERACT platform to enhance the Content delivered to you and your interaction with that Content, for example Survey Monkey or Conference IO.

References in this Policy to ‘we,’ ‘our’ or ‘us’ mean INTERACT Technology. 

Content means any information or data that you interact with, upload, submit, post, create, transmit, store or display in myINTERACT.

 

 

What information we collect about you 

We collect the following information about you when you provide it to us and when other sources provide it to us, as further described below.

 

Information you provide to us

We collect information about you and your company when you register for an account or create your profile, such as your name and email address. We also collect information when you purchase, use, or access myINTERACT (including when you upload, download, complete, modify or share Content). It is important to note that by uploading Content to a Licensed Provider in myINTERACT you are transferring ownership of that information to them.

 

Information shared by other users

In some cases another user (such as an administrator for a Licensed Provider) may create a contact on your behalf and may provide your information (including your name and email address). This can only be done if you have accepted a connection from the Licensed Provider (which you can revoke at any time, via the settings functionality), or have consented to your information being shared.  

Information we collect automatically when you use myINTERACT

We collect other data categories in order to provide our services to you. These include:

Technical data – myINTERACT gathers technical data through browsing and usage information, in particular via the use of cookies. Acceptance of these cookies is required in order to use the platform (see our Terms and Conditions [1] to find out more). We also collect technical data associated with your smartphone, tablet or computer (such as IP addresses, access provider, hardware configuration, software configuration, country of origin), or data associated with the myINTERACT app (such as log and history of all data exchanges, log and history of connections).
Analytics - We collect analytics information when you use myINTERACT to help us improve our products and services.
Google Analytics tool - We use Google Analytics as an analytics provider. Please review Google's Policies and Principles to learn more about Google’s Privacy Terms.   We ensure we use the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on to prevent analytics information from being sent to Google Analytics. At any time, you can disable the collection of analytics from within the settings function of your myINTERCAT.
Analytics derived from Content - We also collect analytics information as a result of running queries against Content across our user base for the purposes of generating Usage Data. "Usage Data" is aggregated data about a group or category of services, features, Content or users that does not contain Personal Information. For example, we may query Content to determine the most common types of Content used by a user group or by searching for the most common audience type to better understand the composition of our user base. Our Licensed Providers can, or may request us to run queries against their Content. For example, in order for them to understand the value of the Content that they are providing their audiences or the impact of any engagement strategies they might use.
Analytics Information from the myINTERACT app - We collect analytics information when you use the myINTERACT app. The app collects: device type/model, OS type and version, network status (offline, 3G, WiFi, etc), whether the application is being used with an external projection screen, geolocation (only if user has authorised it), IP, date/time/duration of viewing material, users’ time zone, identification of material viewed (different depending on type of material), search terms, favourited and rated material. This information is collected to provide more relevant search results based on users’ previous usage patterns. You can disable the collection of analytics from within the Downloaded Applications, however the quality of the service may be deteriorated.
Facebook Analytics is used to collect anonymous information about the number of installs of the application, and the usage over a period of time. This allows for improvements in the software to accommodate the active user base. You can disable the collection of analytics from within the Downloaded Applications.
iCloud Data stored in your own account - The application may collect and store in iCloud a user’s analytics (location, viewing date/time, duration) and users’ preferences (favourites, ratings) for certain asset types. This is collected and synced to your other devices, allowing for consistent search results and recommendations. You can turn off the collection/synchronising of this information to iCloud in the Downloaded Application, however the quality of the product offering will be reduced.
Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies - We use cookies to improve and customise myINTERACT and your experience; to allow you to access and use the Websites or SaaS Products without re-entering your username or password; and to count visits and understand which areas and features of the Websites and SaaS Products are most popular. You can instruct your browser, by changing its options, to stop accepting cookies or to prompt you before accepting a cookie from websites you visit. If you do not accept cookies, however, you may not be able to use all aspects of services and products. 
What Information we receive from other sources

We also obtain information from third parties. For example, we may have access to certain information from a third party social media or authentication service if you log into myINTERACT through the service or otherwise provide us with access to Information from the service. By authorising us to connect with a third party service, you authorise us to access and store your name, email address(es), current city, profile picture URL, and other information that the third party service makes available to us; and to use and disclose it in accordance with this Privacy Policy. You should check your privacy settings on these third party services to understand and change the information sent to us through these services. 

 

How we use your Personal Information

We use the information we collect about you, for the following purposes:

To manage our relationship with you and to provide, personalise and improve your experience with myINTERACT;
Provide, operate, maintain, improve, and promote myINTERACT to you in accordance with your preferences;
Enable you to access and use myINTERACT, including uploading, downloading, collaborating on and sharing Content;
Send transactional messages, including responding to your comments, questions, and requests; providing customer service and support; and sending you technical notices, updates, security alerts, and support and administrative messages;
Send promotional communications, such as providing you with information about services, features, surveys, newsletters, offers, promotions, contests, events and sending updates; and providing other news or information about us and our Licensed Providers. You have the ability to opt-out of receiving any of these communications via the preferences in the myINTERACT app;
Monitor and analyse trends, usage, and activities in connection with myINTERACT to market, promote and drive engagement with the Services;
Investigate and prevent fraudulent transactions, unauthorised access to myINTERACT, and other illegal activities;
Personalise myINTERACT, including providing Content, features, or advertisements that match your interests and preferences;
Enable you to communicate, collaborate, and share Content with users you designate; and
For other purposes about which we obtain your consent.
How we share Information we collect

We share information we collect about you in the ways discussed below. We do not sell information about you to advertisers.

Service Providers, Business Partners and Others
 We work with third party service providers to provide website, application development, hosting, maintenance, back-up, storage, virtual infrastructure, payment processing, analysis and other services for us. These service providers may have access to and/or process your information for the purpose of providing those services for us. We take all reasonable steps to ensure all our service providers and business partners comply with this Privacy Policy.

Third Party Add-Ons
 You may choose to make use of third party Add-Ons in conjunction with the myINTERACT app. Third party Add-Ons are softwares written by third parties to which you grant access privileges to your Content (which may include your Personal Information). When access is granted, your Content is shared with the third party. Third party Add-On policies and procedures are not controlled by INTERACT Technology even though the third party Add-On may be available through the myINTERACT app. Third parties who have been granted access to your Content through Add-Ons will use this data in accordance with their privacy policy/statements - please consider these privacy policies carefully prior to agreeing to sharing your Personal Information.

Links to Third Party Sites
 The INTERACT Services may include links to other websites whose privacy practices may differ from ours. If you submit Personal Information to any of those sites, your information is governed by their privacy policies. We encourage you to carefully read the privacy policy of any website you visit.

Compliance with Laws and Law Enforcement Requests; Protection of Our Rights: 
 We may disclose your information (including your Personal Information) to a third party as required by law, or to respond to an event that may cause serious harm to a person.

Business Transfers
 We may share or transfer your information (including your Personal Information) in connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business to another company. 

Aggregated or Anonymised Data
 We may also share aggregated or anonymised information that does not directly identify you with the third parties described above. 

Collaboration
 As a natural result of using INTERACT Services, you may create Content or add Personal Information and grant permission to other INTERACT users to access it for the purposes of collaboration. Some of the collaboration features of INTERACT Services display your profile information, including Personal Information included in your profile, to Licensed Providers with whom you have connected. Where this information is sensitive, we urge you to use the various security and privacy features of the myINTERACT app to limit access or sharing of the information. Your sharing settings may make any information, including some Personal Information on the myINTERACT app visible to the Licensed Providers that you have connected to, and their audience.

Access by your system administrator
 You should be aware that the administrator of Licensed Providers you have connected to may be able to:

access information about you in the connection;
access communications history to you;
disclose, restrict, or access information that you have provided, or that is made available to you when connecting to that Licensed Provider; and
control how your connection to that Licensed Provider account may be accessed or deleted.
How we store and secure Information we collect

INTERACT hosts data with hosting service providers in countries with strict privacy protections, including Australia and the United States. The servers on which Personal Information is stored are kept in a controlled environment. While we take reasonable efforts to guard your Personal Information, no security system is impenetrable. We cannot guarantee that information will be absolutely safe from intrusion by others, such as hackers. 

As per security best practice we encrypt all data in transit and at rest with the exception of files that are downloaded to a device. Where Downloadable Products are used, responsibility of securing access to the data you store in the Downloadable Products rests with you and not INTERACT. 

How to access and control your Information

Personal Information
 Through your user profile you have the ability to access, update, correct or delete your Personal Information. You can also deactivate your account. You may also direct a privacy query to the Licensed Provider administrator you have connected to or contact us by email: privacy@interact.technology. We will respond to your request within ten (10) business days.

We will retain your account information for as long as your account is active, or as reasonably useful for commercial purposes, or as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. If your account is managed by a Licensed Provider administrator, that account administrator may have control with regards to how your account information is retained and deleted.

Request that we stop using your Information 
 In some cases, you may ask us to stop accessing, storing and otherwise processing your information where you believe we do not have the appropriate rights to do so. For example, if you believe an account was created for you without your permission or you are no longer an active user, you can request that we delete your account as provided in this Policy. Where you make such requests we may need time to investigate and facilitate your request. If you object to information about you being shared with a third-party app, please disable the app or contact your administrator to do so.

Content
 You can remove Content by using the editing tools associated with that Content. In some cases, you may need to contact the Licensed Provider administrator to request they remove the Content. 

Opt-Out
 You may opt-out of receiving promotional communications from INTERACT by using the unsubscribe link within each email, updating your email preferences in your user profile, or emailing us to have your contact information removed from our promotional email list or registration database. Although opt-out requests are usually processed immediately, please allow ten (10) business days for a removal request to be processed. Even after you opt-out from receiving promotional messages from us, you will continue to receive transactional messages from us regarding myINTERACT. You can opt-out of some notification messages in your user profile.

You may be able to opt-out of receiving personalised advertisements from Licensed Providers you are connected to by using the unsubscribe link within each email, updating preferences in that Licensed Providers settings or contacting them directly.  You will be able to opt-out of analytics from within Downloaded Applications, however a certain reduction of quality of service may be experienced as a result.

If you have any queries or complaints about this Policy or our privacy practices please contact us at:
